name: Caelorna, Coral Tyrant
description: A coral tyrant who grew for centuries in a benthic home, feeding on leylines, and emerged bringing her coral depths with her.

description_citations.text: Aetherdrift: card flavor text (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Caelorna emerges from the water, bringing her coral depths with her.
timeline.quote: When she emerged, the coral depths she called home came with her.
